name: Open the Way
oracle_text:
X can't be greater than the number of players in the game.
Reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal X land cards. Put those land cards onto the battlefield tapped and the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
blocked_sentences: X can't be greater than the number of players in the game.

needs.what: a card-level cap on the chosen value of X, read at cast time from a value (here {"player_count": ...}, the number of players in the game), so the cast offers no X above it
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No card_level_cost_key or card_level_rider_key bounds X; the engine's ask_x has only a min_x floor (from cast_lock_min_x) and max_x is merely what is affordable, so X would be unbounded and the spell would put arbitrarily many lands onto the battlefield, strictly better than printed. The second sentence is expressible with reveal_until (amount x, selector Land, destination battlefield, tapped, rest_to_bottom)
